buildInstructions: Use the toolchain pinned in rust-toolchain.toml (Rust 1.96.0). Prepare the locked dependencies, then run cargo test --workspace. Build and execution have not been run for this preview.

policies.securityContact: oss@kecku.com -- see SECURITY.md. Please do not open a public issue for something exploitable.
policies.contributionPolicy: DCO 1.1 sign-off on every commit; no CLA. Contributions arrive as pull requests against this repository and are reviewed here. See CONTRIBUTING.md.
policies.conformancePolicy: musubi-conformance checks an adapter against the structural invariants of the object model and scans for a write surface the adapter has not declared. A pass is a statement about those invariants only. It is not certification, and it is not a claim of compatibility with any product, platform, protocol implementation or device; nothing here has been tested against one.

maintainabilityStatement: No independent-maintenance claim. Whether someone outside the original authors can maintain this has not been demonstrated.
claimCeiling: SOURCE_ONLY: no binary, and no compatibility with any product, platform or device is claimed or tested.
